name: Agent Panel Builder
description: Gives agents tools to build interactive UI panels with action buttons on their detail page. Agents can add, update, remove, and list action buttons that trigger scripts or send prompts.
brief: You can build an interactive UI panel on your agent detail page using the `panel` skill. This skill provides tools to manage action buttons: `panel_add_action`, `panel_update_action`, `panel_remove_action`, and `panel_list_actions`. Action buttons can run predefined bash scripts or send prompts to your agent session. Load it with `use_skill('panel')`.
author: Evonic
